verdict.rationale: Proton Pass's official CLI gives programmatic CRUD over vaults and many item types (passwords, notes, cards, identities, WiFi, custom, SSH keys), plus secret retrieval for scripts and CI/CD pipelines. That covers the core item-management surface of the UI, but there is no evidence of a general public API or of parity for the many other UI features. missing for 10: a documented public API (beyond the CLI), programmatic coverage of vault sharing, hide-my-email aliases and custom domains, Pass Monitor, passkeys, TOTP, Emergency Access, file attachments and import/export, plus any independent corroboration of the CLI's coverage.
